name: Risk-parity sleeve
notes: Trades from 2021 (~5 years). Equal-weight exposure to four asset classes -- equities, duration, gold and commodities -- so macro regime attribution can read each beta clearly. Linked to the official risk-parity and global-macro sleeves.
objective: Equal risk contribution from equities, duration, gold and commodities.
constraints: Four-asset maximum; quarterly risk rebalance; 10bp cost.
